# Sanctify Goa Business Directory

> Sanctify Goa Business Directory (goa.sanctify.in) is an online local business
> directory and classifieds portal for Goa, India. It lists verified shops,
> services and businesses across Goa - including hotels, salons & spas, car and
> bike services, interior decorators, optical stores, flower shops and more -
> with contact details, addresses and descriptions.

## About
- Name: Sanctify Goa Business Directory
- Region served: Goa, India (Vasco da Gama, Dabolim, Margao, Sancoale, Zuarinagar, Candolim and other towns in North & South Goa)
- Contact: +91 99233 52923
- Operated by: SANCTIFY (https://www.sanctify.in)
